notes: App Store screenshot captions, in listing order (the first three show in search results). screen = raw capture name from tests/visual/appstore.spec.ts; accent = the phrase drawn in the signal colour; theme night = the night signal for a night-mode screen. Headlines <= 5 words, sublines one line and device-neutral (the iPad set uses them too). Every claim must be something the iOS app really does (guideline 2.3): tests/unit/storeshots/claims.test.js checks forecast lengths, the night chart and the MPA data against the code. held = names kept out of the captions until the owner decides on them; each says why.

held.First Mate: the assistant's name is open (docs/launch/aso.md, owner decisions 2 and 5): Mercury and Furuno ship First Mate marine apps
